scripts.dev: bun run db:start && (bun run dev:back & bun run dev:front)
scripts.dev:tauri: bun run db:start && (bun run dev:back & cd src-tauri && tauri dev)
scripts.dev:ios: bun run db:start && (bun run dev:back & cd src-tauri && tauri ios dev)
scripts.build: bun run build:back && bun run build:front
scripts.test: bun run test:back && bun run test:front
scripts.lint: bun run check:docs && bun run lint:back && bun run lint:front
scripts.lint:front: cd front && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run knip
scripts.eval: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cargo run -q -p promptus_back --bin eval --
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && bun run db:start
